etymology.historical_story: Edmund continues the Old English personal name Eadmund, combining elements associated with wealth and protection. These elements belong to the name's historical formation, rather than productive Malay morphology. In a Malay sentence, Edmund functions as a person's name and retains its capital letter. Its historical meaning does not describe the present-day bearer's character. See the [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/name/Edmund).

morphology.formula: eye + -s → eyes（英语名词复数或动词第三人称单数）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语屈折形式，不是马来语派生词。-s 在元音 /aɪ/ 后读 /z/，全词一个音节。数据包中的 eyes 不是英语基础词形；标准马来语对应词须按语境选择 mata、memandang 等。

senses.zh_definition: 英语 eye 的复数，指眼睛；也可在英语表达中引申指目光或看法。
senses.en_definition: The plural of eye: the organs of sight, also used figuratively for someone's gaze or perspective.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian editorial bagi bentuk bahasa Inggeris, bukan takrif rasmi DBP: bentuk jamak eye, iaitu mata; dalam ungkapan tertentu, pandangan.
senses.nuances: 按英语形式解释，不标为官方马来语词。标准马来语 mata 本身不强制标示单复数；需要强调双眼时可说 kedua-dua belah mata。以下搭配保留英语原文并附马来语对应表达。[Cambridge Dictionary：eye](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/eye)

collocations.ms: blue eyes — padanan Melayu: mata biru

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词 eye 的一般现在时第三人称单数，指带着兴趣、怀疑或欲望打量、注视。
senses.en_definition: The third-person singular present of eye: looks at someone or something with interest or scrutiny.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian editorial bagi bentuk bahasa Inggeris, bukan takrif rasmi DBP: bentuk orang ketiga tunggal bagi kata kerja eye, iaitu memandang dengan minat atau meneliti.
senses.nuances: 例如 she eyes the cake 中，eyes 是动词，不是“眼睛”的复数。马来语译法随语境而定，可用 memandang、memerhatikan 或 mengamati，不套用英语主谓一致词尾。[Cambridge Dictionary：eye，动词](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/eye)

collocations.ms: eyes the food — padanan Melayu: memandang makanan itu dengan penuh minat
eyes him suspiciously — padanan Melayu: memandangnya dengan curiga

etymology.historical_story: English uses eyes for both a plural noun and a present-tense verb. Their identical spelling can obscure two different grammatical jobs. When an English token appears in a Malay subtitle list, it may represent quoted dialogue or language switching rather than an established Malay borrowing. The original sentence is therefore essential for choosing between mata and a verb such as memandang.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /aɪz/，末尾是 /z/；先看位置：her eyes 多半是“她的眼睛”，she eyes 则是“她打量”。

morphology.pattern_note: 德语姓氏，作为完整专名记忆；所列音标为德语读音，不代表已核定的马来语标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 爱因斯坦：姓氏，在科学语境中通常指物理学家阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦，以相对论研究闻名。
senses.en_definition: Einstein, a surname usually referring in scientific contexts to Albert Einstein, the physicist associated with relativity.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang, dalam konteks sains, lazimnya merujuk kepada Albert Einstein, ahli fizik yang terkenal dengan teori relativiti.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，正常书写为 Einstein；输入中的小写仅保留为检索键。此处马来语释义为编写释义，并非 DBP 普通词条原文。不能直接把英语中表示“天才”的戏谑用法视为已确立的马来语独立义项。

etymology.historical_story: Einstein enters Malay scientific discussion as a personal name rather than a Malay formation. DBP's encyclopedic material identifies Albert Einstein with relativity, while its terminology records preserve his surname in expressions such as pekali Einstein. These uses show how a scientist's name can become part of technical vocabulary without becoming an ordinary Malay root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Einstein 的读音“爱因施泰因”与“爱因斯坦—相对论”连在一起；这是姓名联想，不是马来语词根拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。DBP 标音为 é.lé.men，前两个 e 为 é，末音节 e 为央元音 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 具有某种组成要素或特征
各项要素；多个组成部分

senses.zh_definition: 要素；组成部分；构成某个整体的成分或因素。
senses.en_definition: A constituent part, feature, or factor of a larger whole.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menjadi bahagian dalam sesuatu keseluruhan; unsur atau anasir.
senses.nuances: 现代通用义，常见于教育、设计、文学和工作汇报。强调某项内容构成整体的一部分；不自动等于表示评判标准的 kriteria，也不完全等于表示区别性特征的 ciri。

senses.zh_definition: 化学元素；由原子序数相同的原子组成、不能通过化学方法进一步分解的物质。
senses.en_definition: A chemical element consisting of atoms with the same atomic number.
senses.ms_definition: Zat yang terdiri daripada atom sejenis dan tidak dapat diuraikan menjadi zat yang lebih ringkas melalui kaedah kimia.
senses.nuances: DBP《Kamus Pelajar》收录的科学义。马来西亚化学教材通常使用 unsur 或 unsur kimia；不得将此义与化合物 sebatian 混淆。

senses.zh_definition: 电热元件；利用电阻产生热量的电器部件。
senses.en_definition: An electrical resistance component that produces heat.
senses.ms_definition: Wayar perintang aliran elektrik yang menjadi alat pemanas pada peralatan elektrik.
senses.nuances: 技术和维修语境常用义，通常说 elemen pemanas。这里指产生热量的部件，不是发电装置。

senses.zh_definition: 传统宇宙观中的基本元素，指土、水、火、风之一。
senses.en_definition: One of the traditional elements: earth, water, fire, or air.
senses.ms_definition: Salah satu daripada empat unsur, iaitu tanah, air, api dan angin, yang dianggap sebagai bahan dasar alam semesta.
senses.nuances: 用于传统观念、哲学或文化叙述。属于历史性分类体系，不能当作现代化学对物质的分类。

senses.zh_definition: 电化学电池；通过化学反应产生电能的装置。
senses.en_definition: An electrochemical cell that generates electrical energy through chemical reactions.
senses.ms_definition: Alat untuk menghasilkan tenaga elektrik secara kimia.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》将此义标为 Id，即印度尼西亚用法；《Kamus Pelajar》亦收录。马来西亚现代技术表述宜优先使用 sel elektrokimia。下列为该专门义的术语搭配，不代表日常高频用法。

etymology.historical_story: Elemen belongs to the international vocabulary associated with English element and Dutch element, ultimately connected with Latin elementum. Its dictionary meanings preserve several ways of imagining basic parts: constituents of a whole, chemical substances, traditional earth–water–fire–air categories, and electrical components. This relationship helps explain its semantic range, although the immediate borrowing route into Malaysian Malay is not established by the supplied packet.

morphology.formula: ∅ + express → express; 马来语规范对应形式：ekspres
morphology.pattern_note: express 是英语拼写，不能拆成马来语词缀。原包的 sst 不是有效音节划分；英语可分为 ex.press，马来语规范形式分为 eks.pres，读 /eks.pres/。本条 IPA 对应英语拼写。原包未提供 Jawi，不将 ekspres 的 Jawi 擅自移填给 express。

word_family.gloss: 规范马来语对应词：快速的；特快的

senses.zh_definition: 快速的；特快的。英语形式 express 可见于商业标签、品牌或语码混用；规范马来语拼写为 ekspres。
senses.en_definition: Fast or expedited, especially of transport or delivery services; the English spelling corresponding to standard Malay ekspres.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi padanan baku ekspres: cepat, pantas atau segera, khususnya tentang perkhidmatan pengangkutan dan penghantaran.
senses.nuances: express 不应作为规范马来语拼写教授；以下搭配采用规范形式 ekspres。输入要求的 official 在本条仅保留为数据记录状态，不表示英语拼写获得马来语规范认证。英语动词 express 的“表达”义不能直接套入马来语，通常应按语境使用 menyatakan 或 meluahkan。

etymology.historical_story: English express has a conventional Malay counterpart, ekspres. In the adaptation, x is represented by ks and the doubled final s becomes a single s. Malaysian transport vocabulary makes this form especially visible in bas ekspres. English spellings may remain in names and informal messages, but the dictionary headword is ekspres. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=ekspres), [UKM linguistic study](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/4969/2523)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 express，就联想“特快”；写规范马来语时，把 x 展开成 ks、把 ss 缩成 s：express → ekspres。

morphology.formula: Jika konteks mengesahkan singkatan: Elaun Mencari Pekerjaan → EMP; Environmental Management Plan → EMP

senses.zh_definition: 仅在马来西亚就业保险语境中：EMP 为 Elaun Mencari Pekerjaan 的缩写，指向符合条件的失业参保人提供的求职津贴。
senses.en_definition: In Malaysian employment-insurance contexts, EMP abbreviates Elaun Mencari Pekerjaan, the Job Search Allowance for eligible insured people who have lost employment.

etymology.historical_story: The letters EMP illustrate how administrative abbreviations cross languages. Malaysian employment-insurance materials use the initials of Elaun Mencari Pekerjaan, while environmental documents retain the English initials of Environmental Management Plan alongside a Malay title. These documented uses explain two possible readings, but neither establishes the origin or intended meaning of the isolated lowercase token emp.

etymology.historical_story: Ekspedisi belongs to an international family of expedition words ultimately associated with Latin expeditio, meaning military preparations or a campaign. Its military background helps explain the first Malay dictionary sense. The journey sense now also covers research and exploration. The precise language through which the Malay form was borrowed is not established by the supplied packet. [Académie française：expédition](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9E3427)

senses.zh_definition: 生物演化：生物的遗传特征在世代传承中发生变化的过程。
senses.en_definition: Evolution: change in the inherited characteristics of organisms across generations.
senses.ms_definition: Perubahan pada ciri yang diwarisi oleh hidupan daripada satu generasi kepada generasi berikutnya.
senses.nuances: 用于生物学中的跨世代变化，不指单个个体长大；演化也不必然意味着变得更复杂或更优越。DBP 收录了动物、植物逐代变化这一义项；此处释义为现代生物学表述，非逐字引文。参见[PRPM：evolusi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=evolusi)。

senses.zh_definition: 事物、制度、技术或社会形态随时间逐步发生的发展与变化。
senses.en_definition: The gradual development or transformation of something over time.
senses.ms_definition: Perkembangan atau perubahan sesuatu secara beransur-ansur, termasuk perubahan bentuk atau susunannya.
senses.nuances: 常用于科技、社会和文化的发展。与 revolusi 所强调的剧烈或根本性变革相比，通常突出渐进过程；不保证结果一定更好。参见[PRPM：evolusi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=evolusi)。

etymology.historical_story: Evolusi belongs to an international vocabulary ultimately connected with Latin evolutio, the unrolling of something such as a scroll. The image of unfolding developed into a way of describing change over time. Malay uses the word for biological evolution and gradual development more generally; the immediate borrowing route is not established here. See the [Académie française dictionary](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9E3179).

etymology.historical_story: Elaine belongs to the Helen and Ellen name family and became familiar through medieval Arthurian stories. Historical name research notes that its distinctive spelling was influenced by Welsh forms. The ultimate origin of the underlying Greek name is uncertain, so a neat translation such as 'shining light' should not be presented as an established Malay meaning. [Medieval names research](https://dmnes.wordpress.com/2016/03/17/arthurian-names-elaine/)

senses.nuances: 适用于友谊、亲情、合作关系及比喻性的联系。hubungan erat 可以是机构或国家之间的密切关系，并不暗示恋爱关系。强调关系牢固时可用 erat；强调空间距离近则通常用 dekat。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：erat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=erat)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay erat connects physical firmness with social closeness: a hand can hold tightly, and a friendship can remain strong. This semantic connection is documented in the dictionary rather than reconstructed as an origin story. Its derivatives let speakers describe strengthening both tangible fastenings and the less visible bonds between people. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=erat)

etymology.historical_story: English enterprise came through Middle English from Anglo-French, ultimately from entreprendre, meaning to undertake. That history connects a difficult undertaking with the business organisation created to pursue it. Enterprises adds the English plural ending. In Malaysian multilingual reading, recognising that ending helps distinguish an English business term from the Malay equivalents used to translate it. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/enterprise)

etymology.historical_story: Emosional belongs to an international vocabulary for describing feelings and reactions. Its resemblance to English emotional helps learners recognize it, but Malay usage has its own boundaries. Kamus Dewan emphasizes displaying emotion or acting according to feelings, making the word especially useful when discussing personal reactions, sensitive conversations, and judgment.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 emosi，就想到“情绪”；emosional 描写情绪明显流露、甚至牵着行动走的人或反应。

etymology.historical_story: English everything joins every and thing, with the combined expression recorded in late Middle English. Its ordinary meaning gathers all relevant items into one expression; figurative uses make one person or concern stand for all that matters. In a Malay conversation, its English history remains distinct from the local grammatical frame surrounding it. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/everything).

etymology.historical_story: Eonni represents Korean 언니 in Roman letters. Its two dictionary senses connect family relationship with social closeness: a woman may use it for an older sister or affectionately for an older woman outside her family. In Malay conversation, retaining this Korean address can signal shared interest in Korean culture and an agreed sense of familiarity. [Korean dictionary](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=31971&nation=eng)

etymology.historical_story: English end continues Old English ende and belongs to an old Germanic word family. Its meanings connect a physical limit with a conclusion and an intended result. In this entry, it is treated as an English item encountered within Malay communication; the supplied token does not establish when, or whether, it became an accepted Malay borrowing. [Collins dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/end)

etymology.historical_story: English echo ultimately comes from Greek ēchō, through Latin and French. Greek mythology also personified Echo as a nymph whose voice remained after her body faded. The returning sound therefore has both a physical meaning and a memorable literary association. This history explains the English word, rather than establishing official Malay status. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/echo)

etymology.historical_story: Eksklusif belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English exclusive. In Malay, its spelling preserves recognisable consonant groups while using the ending -if. Its established uses connect several social settings: a select club, a right held by one party, and an interview obtained by one broadcaster. Each involves a boundary around access or participation.

word_family.gloss: 规避；回避的行为或过程

senses.zh_definition: 闪避；通过移动身体或改变位置，避开打击、刺击或迎面而来的危险。
senses.en_definition: To dodge or move out of the way of a blow, thrust, or approaching danger.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak atau menyisihkan diri supaya tidak terkena pukulan, tikaman atau bahaya yang menghampiri.
senses.nuances: 词典常在词根 elak 下解释 mengelak。完整叙述通常使用带前缀的形式；裸词根常见于口语、指令及简短提示。

senses.zh_definition: 回避；设法不接触某人、某话题，或使自己免于承担责任、接受指控等。
senses.en_definition: To evade an obligation or accusation, or avoid a person, subject, or encounter.
senses.ms_definition: Mencari jalan untuk menjauhkan atau melepaskan diri daripada tanggungjawab, tuduhan, pertemuan atau perkara tertentu.
senses.nuances: mengelak daripada 常接要回避的事情或行为。指逃避责任时通常带批评意味；指暂时避开敏感话题时，评价取决于语境。

senses.zh_definition: 避免；采取措施，使不希望发生的事情不出现，或不做某项行为。
senses.en_definition: To avoid an unwanted outcome or refrain from an action.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil langkah supaya sesuatu yang tidak diingini tidak berlaku, atau tidak melakukan sesuatu perbuatan.
senses.nuances: 裸词根 elak 表达这一义项常见于口语和简短提示。正式完整句通常根据句法使用 mengelakkan 或 elakkan，例如 mengelakkan kesilapan。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=elak)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect elak with the physical act of moving aside to escape a blow or thrust. They also record avoiding duties or accusations. These meanings offer a useful conceptual bridge: a person can step out of the path of a weapon or figuratively step away from an unwanted obligation. [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=elak).

senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不能把名字本身释为“摇滚歌手”或“猫王”。未核实其作为 DBP 普通词条的收录，因此不标为官方词条；马来语释义为编辑性说明。以下搭配用于指 Elvis Presley，并非固定习语。人物资料参见 [Graceland：Elvis 简介](https://www.graceland.com/quick-facts)。

etymology.historical_story: Elvis is a personal name whose original meaning remains uncertain. Its modern cultural prominence owes much to Elvis Presley, the American singer associated with rock and roll. In Malay conversation, a reference to lagu Elvis may therefore identify a familiar musical repertoire without the surname. This cultural recognition does not create a Malay root or a new common-noun meaning. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/elvis), [Graceland](https://www.graceland.com/quick-facts).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 Elvis，联想 Elvis Presley 和舞台上的猫王；这是人物联想，不是名字的字面词义。

etymology.historical_story: Eye is inherited English vocabulary, descending through Middle English from Old English ēage. Related forms include German Auge, showing that the word belongs to an older Germanic family. Its appearance in a Malay conversation should therefore be distinguished from Malay derivation: the ordinary Malay word for the organ is mata. [Merriam-Webster: eye](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/eye)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: eye 与英语 I 同音 /aɪ/；想象“我用眼睛看”。切换到马来语时，把身体部位记作 mata。

word_family.gloss: 遵守道德原则的；合乎伦理的

senses.zh_definition: 伦理学；研究善恶、对错及道德原则的学问。
senses.en_definition: The study of moral principles and questions of right and wrong.
senses.ms_definition: Ilmu yang mengkaji prinsip akhlak atau moral serta persoalan baik buruk dan betul salah.
senses.nuances: 指学科或理论研究时，相当于英语 ethics 或 moral philosophy，不只是社交礼貌。两项核心义均据 [DBP：etika](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ETIKA)。

senses.zh_definition: 个人、群体或职业所遵循的道德原则、伦理准则或行为规范。
senses.en_definition: Moral principles or standards governing an individual, group or profession.
senses.ms_definition: Prinsip moral atau nilai akhlak yang menjadi pegangan seseorang individu atau sesuatu kumpulan.
senses.nuances: 常见于职业操守、研究规范与公共责任。etika 比一般的 sopan santun“礼貌”范围更广；失礼行为与严重职业伦理违规不能简单等同。

etymology.historical_story: Etika belongs to an international family of scholarly terms ultimately associated with Greek ethos and ethikos, concerning character and conduct. Malay uses the word both for philosophical inquiry and for practical moral standards. That connection explains why the same term appears in university discussions, workplace codes and professional responsibilities. [Universiti Malaysia Sabah](https://openbook.ums.edu.my/asaspemikiranfalsafah/chapter/konsep-politik/)

etymology.historical_story: English even has an old Germanic history: its adjective continues Old English efen, while the adverb continues efne. Its presence in a Malay conversation represents English vocabulary being inserted into Malay speech, rather than Malay affixation. This entry therefore separates its conversational usefulness from recognition as a standard Malay headword. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/even)

etymology.historical_story: Eden belongs to the regional first-person vocabulary documented for Negeri Sembilan Malay, alongside den and ese. A local dialect survey shows that these choices carry social meaning: close friends in some districts use eden, while respectful encounters favour ese. Other districts allow eden more broadly. Its regional history should not be confused with the biblical name Eden. etymology.historical_story: Emaknya combines an everyday Malay kinship word with a third-person possessive element. Rather than creating a new family relationship, -nya links the mother to someone already identifiable in the conversation. This compact construction lets a speaker continue a family story without repeatedly naming the person whose mother is being discussed. senses.ms_definition: Padanan penerangan bahasa Melayu: pokok renek atau pokok kecil daripada genus Sambucus.

etymology.historical_story: The age-related elder descends from Old English ieldra, a comparative of eald, meaning old. The same spelling also names a plant, but that word comes from Old English ellærn. These separate histories explain why elder can describe a senior person or a flowering shrub without any original connection between the meanings. [Word histories](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/elder)

etymology.historical_story: English exhale traces through Middle English to Latin exhalare, combining an outward-direction element with a verb meaning to breathe. Exhales adds the ordinary English present-tense ending for a third-person singular subject. That ending belongs to English grammar; its presence in Malay subtitles or mixed-language material does not make it a Malay suffix. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/exhale)

etymology.historical_story: Emmett belongs to English naming history rather than a demonstrated Malay word family. Its surname origins are multiple: some families are associated with Emmot near Colne in Lancashire, others with Emmett in Devon, and another origin involves Emmot, a familiar form of Emma. A shared modern spelling therefore does not establish one ancestral story for every bearer. See the [Guild of One-Name Studies](https://one-name.org/name_profile/emmett/).

etymology.historical_story: Ehwal belongs to the Arabic-derived vocabulary of Malay, corresponding to aḥwāl, the plural of ḥāl, meaning a condition or state. Malay treats the borrowed form as a single lexical item rather than applying Arabic number rules. Its established pairing with hal now appears in administrative expressions covering student, religious, domestic, and international affairs. Modern examples are recorded in [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139612&keyword=hal+ehwal).

etymology.historical_story: English dictionaries record ew as a vocal expression of disgust, also written eww. Dictionary.com dates its earliest recorded use to 1965–70. Its expressive spelling can be lengthened to suggest a prolonged reaction. When inserted into Malay conversation, it should be understood as an English expression rather than evidence of an inherited Malay root. See [Dictionary.com: ew](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/ew).

etymology.historical_story: Erica has two distinct naming histories: the personal name is a feminine form of Eric, while the botanical name continues an ancient Greek word for heather through Latin. Their identical spelling does not make them a single Malay word with one origin. Context distinguishes a person's name from a scientific plant name. Sources: [name history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Erica), [Kew botanical history](https://www.kew.org/sites/default/files/2022-03/Botanical%20Illustrations%20List%20mar%202022.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Efektif belongs to an international vocabulary of results, comparable to English effective and Dutch effectief. Their European word family reaches back to Latin effectivus, associated with producing or accomplishing something. This historical connection helps explain the modern meaning: a method earns this description through its results. The immediate borrowing route into Malaysian Malay is not established here. [European etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/effective)

etymology.historical_story: Everdeen carries a literary connection rather than a Malay derivational history. Suzanne Collins has linked Katniss's surname to Bathsheba Everdene, the independent heroine of Thomas Hardy's Far from the Madding Crowd. Notice the different endings: Everdeen and Everdene. The connection concerns an author's naming choice; it does not justify inventing a literal Malay meaning or splitting the surname into Malay morphemes. [TIME](https://time.com/3848696/carey-mulligan-far-from-the-madding-crowd/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 EV-er-deen，就联想 Katniss 的弓箭：这是人物姓氏，整词记住；不要把 ever 或 deen 当成马来语词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Edwards belongs to the English and Welsh surname tradition. Its final -s is historically associated with a genitival formation from Edward, often explained as indicating descent from someone named Edward. A modern bearer, however, inherits a surname rather than a literal description of their father. Malay therefore retains Edwards as a complete personal name instead of translating its historical components. [Dictionary of American Family Names, via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/edwards)

etymology.historical_story: Every developed from an Old English expression combining the equivalents of ever and each, passing through Middle English forms such as everich. Its history reflects an insistence on including each member without omission. For Malay learners, that distributive meaning provides a useful bridge to setiap, although particular English expressions sometimes require a different translation. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/every).

senses.zh_definition: 西方民间传说或奇幻作品中的精灵；外形、体型和能力因传统或作品设定而异。
senses.en_definition: A supernatural being in Western folklore or fantasy, whose appearance and powers vary by tradition or fictional setting.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan, padanannya bagi makhluk cerita rakyat ialah orang halus atau orang bunian.
senses.nuances: PRPM 将其列在英语词典栏目，不能据此认定 elf 是已规范化的马来语普通词。orang bunian 是文化近似译法，两类传说生物并非完全相同。该英马词典另列英语比喻义“淘气的小孩”，但这不证明同一用法已进入马来语。以下为奇幻语境中的自然组合，未作频率排序。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=elf)

etymology.historical_story: Elf continues an Old English word, ælf, rather than a Malay root. Its long history belongs to Germanic traditions about supernatural beings. Later storytelling presents many different kinds of elves, so a tiny playful creature and a stately fantasy character can share the same English label without sharing every cultural association. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/elf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: elf /ɛlf/：想象一个名牌上写着 ELF 的奇幻精灵；用角色画面记住读音，不把它与马来传说中的 bunian 完全画等号。

etymology.historical_story: Egois belongs to an international vocabulary built around ego, the Latin word for 'I'. Malay spelling guidance explicitly pairs English egoist with Malay egois, illustrating the adaptation of final -ist to -is. The dictionary meaning centres on the person who puts themselves first, while related egoisme names the attitude. [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 ego，想到“我”；egois 就是把“我”摆在所有人前面的人。

senses.zh_definition: 帝国：由同一最高统治者或政权统辖的多个国家、民族或领土。
senses.en_definition: A group of territories or peoples governed by a single supreme ruler or power.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu: empayar, iaitu kumpulan negeri atau wilayah di bawah pemerintahan satu kuasa yang berdaulat.
senses.nuances: empire 是英语形式，不能据此认定为规范马来语词形。正式马来语使用 empayar；专名、英语引文和语码转换可保留 empire。以下搭配采用规范马来语对应词。[DBP：empayar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=empayar)

senses.zh_definition: 商业帝国：由同一人物或集团控制、规模庞大且影响力强的企业体系。

etymology.historical_story: English empire came through Old French from Latin imperium, meaning command or sovereign authority. Modern usage extends territorial rule into the world of business: someone can control an empire of companies without governing a country. Malay expresses these political and commercial meanings with the established spelling empayar. [Etymological reference](https://dictionary.obspm.fr/terms/empire/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=empayar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 empire 和 empayar 成对记：同一幅帝国版图，英语写 empire，马来语写 empayar。

morphology.pattern_note: e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/；马来西亚常见读法中，词根末尾 k 实现为 /ʔ/，ny 读 /ɲ/。-nya 可表达强调、名词化或指代，须依句法判断。输入包的 Jawi ايلوق 是词根形式；带 -nya 的完整形式为 ايلوقڽ。

senses.nuances: -nya 在此加强感叹，不表示“他的”或“它的”。如 Eloknya taman ini! 表示“这个花园真漂亮”，而不是“它的花园”。词根的美丽与良好两义见 DBP。[DBP：elok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=elok)

senses.ms_definition: Sifat, keadaan atau tahap keelokan sesuatu yang diketahui daripada konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处 -nya 使形容词具有名词性。在 elok buruknya 中表示好坏；在 dengan eloknya 中，整个介词短语作方式状语，意为妥善地或整齐美观地。DBP 的双语例句收录 dengan eloknya。[DBP：用例](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=elok)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Eloknya kita… 用“我们最好……”提出共同建议，通常比直接要求对方做事更委婉；语气仍会影响是否显得在指责。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 同事或朋友之间适合用来商量。向长辈或上司建议时，可配合称谓及 jika sesuai 等表达；正式公文中的建议可写 seelok-eloknya。

etymology.historical_story: Older Malay dictionaries already record elok across beauty, excellence and pleasing appearance, showing that its meaning reaches beyond physical attractiveness. Eloknya combines this established word with multifunctional -nya. Context then turns a judgment of goodness into admiration, a reference to quality, or a gentle recommendation about what would be best. [Historical Malay dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/An_abridged_Malay-English_dictionary_%28romanized%29_%28IA_afu7967.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 elok＝好、美；句首 eloknya 想成“最好呀”，感叹时想成“真好呀”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入；首音节 e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/。不可把词尾 -or 当作马来语能产后缀。

senses.nuances: 核心是出版前的内容处理，职责可包括选稿、结构调整和语言修订；不等同于作者，也不限于校对错字。editor kopi 特指处理文字准确性及体例一致性的编辑。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=editor)

senses.nuances: 属于计算机语境，通常通过 editor teks、editor kod 等限定语与职业义区分。DBP 的计算机词典亦使用 penyunting。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=editor)

etymology.historical_story: Malay editor belongs to the international vocabulary of publishing. Its deeper Latin ancestor, editor, referred to someone who brought something forth or published it. That image still suits the modern role: an editor helps bring a writer's work before readers. Malay also uses penyunting for this work. [University of Chicago Press](https://press.uchicago.edu/dam/ucp/books/pdf/course_intro/978-0-226-29997-6_course_intro.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 editor 和熟悉的 edit 连起来：把稿子 edit 好、送到读者面前的人，就是 editor；马来语按 e-di-tor 三拍读。

senses.zh_definition: 企业；从事商业或生产活动的经营组织。
senses.en_definition: A business organization or commercial undertaking.
senses.ms_definition: Syarikat atau organisasi yang menjalankan kegiatan perniagaan atau perusahaan.
senses.nuances: PRPM 将此拼写列在《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》的英语词条中，并提供 syarikat 等马来语对应词；不能仅凭这一收录认定 enterprise 是规范马来语普通词。以下搭配以马来语对译为主，括号保留英语搭配。企业名称中的 Enterprise 本身不能充分说明其法律组织形式。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enterprise)

senses.ms_definition: Usaha atau projek yang memerlukan kesungguhan, keberanian atau kesediaan menghadapi risiko.
senses.nuances: 这是英语的 undertaking 义，马来语通常依语境使用 usaha 或 projek；不一定涉及成立企业。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enterprise)

senses.zh_definition: 进取心；主动开创新事业并愿意承担风险的精神和能力。
senses.en_definition: Initiative and willingness to undertake challenging or risky activities.
senses.ms_definition: Daya usaha serta kesediaan memulakan kegiatan baharu dan menghadapi cabaran.
senses.nuances: 这是英语抽象名词义，通常不可数；马来语对应 daya usaha，不指某一家企业。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enterprise)

senses.zh_definition: 企业经营活动；尤指某种所有制或经济制度下的商业活动。
senses.en_definition: Business activity, especially within a particular ownership or economic system.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan perusahaan atau perniagaan dalam sesuatu sistem pemilikan atau ekonomi.
senses.nuances: 强调商业活动或经营制度，而非单个组织。马来语通常用 perusahaan，再加 swasta、awam 或 bebas 等限定语。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enterprise)

etymology.historical_story: English enterprise came through French from a word meaning something undertaken. Its history connects taking on a task with the initiative needed to attempt it, helping explain its modern senses of venture, business and resourcefulness. In Malay contexts, those meanings require different equivalents rather than one automatic translation. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/enterprise)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 enterprise 连到“开展一番事业”：实体是企业，行动是事业，精神是进取；这是语义联想，不是词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 不按马来语词缀拆分。英语人名通常读作 /ˈiːvi/，具体读音以本人使用为准；规范书写首字母大写。

etymology.historical_story: Everest commemorates George Everest, a former Surveyor General of India. His successor, Andrew Waugh, proposed the name, which Britain's Royal Geographical Society adopted in 1865. The mountain also has established regional names, including Chomolungma and Sagarmatha. Its international English name therefore reflects surveying history rather than a Malay description of height or mountains. [Library of Congress](https://blogs.loc.gov/maps/2018/03/extremities-of-the-earth-the-highest-point-from-sea-level/), [Royal Society: George Everest](https://catalogues.royalsociety.org/CalmView/Record.aspx?id=NA1188&src=CalmView.Persons)

[eBay official history](https://www.ebayinc.com/company/our-history/).

etymology.historical_story: One documented naming story belongs specifically to the Lotus Elise. Lotus unveiled the car at Frankfurt in 1995 and named it after Elisa, granddaughter of its then chairman Romano Artioli. This explains that vehicle's name, but it does not establish which Elise the input denotes or make elise a Malay common word. Source: [Lotus](https://www.lotuscars.com/en-GB/lotus-story/road-cars/elise).

etymology.historical_story: Evakuasi belongs to an international vocabulary family ultimately associated with Latin evacuare, meaning to empty out. The historical image is clearing a place; modern emergency usage focuses on moving people to safety. Malaysian disaster planning documents use pelan evakuasi. The precise intermediary language through which this form entered Malaysian usage is not established here. [Etymological reference](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=evacuate)

etymology.historical_story: The English entry is illustrated by a 1961 retelling of Beowulf, where the plural eldermen accompanies Hrothgar. That literary setting helps explain the association with male community leaders. It does not demonstrate borrowing into Malay. The spelling alone also cannot establish that a particular occurrence denotes a municipal officer rather than a community elder.

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于名词的后接成分，通常回指上下文中的所属对象；词根不发生音变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入中的 ايکور 是词根 ekor 的 Jawi，完整形式补写为 ايکورڽ。音节划分根据整词补全。

etymology.historical_story: The familiar animal tail supplies the image behind several Malay uses of ekor: a physical tail, a trailing attachment, and the rear of a procession. Ekornya combines that noun with -nya to identify the tail through context. These everyday extensions provide a useful cultural picture, without requiring an unverified claim about the word's earliest historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: Efraim represents the Hebrew name commonly rendered Ephraim in English. Genesis 41:52 connects Joseph's naming of his second son with becoming fruitful in a land of suffering. Biblical tradition subsequently associates the name with a tribe and its territory. The narrative association is clear, although the name's precise historical formation remains debated. [NET Bible](https://classic.net.bible.org/passage.php?passage=Gen+41%3A52&theme=wiki)

etymology.historical_story: Ekstra belongs to an international word family ultimately connected with Latin extra, meaning outside or beyond. Its Malay spelling represents the consonant sequence written x in English extra with ks. DBP records the everyday meaning additional and illustrates it with pelakon ekstra, linking the word to the background performers who help populate a scene. [Sources: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/extra), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ekstra).

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian forestry literature records eben among the names associated with ebony from Sulawesi. In this setting, the word belongs to the vocabulary of timber identification and trade. Indonesian craft teaching materials also use kayu eben when discussing carving woods. These records establish a cultural and commercial context, but they do not establish the word’s borrowing route or its official standing in Malaysian Malay. [Indonesian craft textbook](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/5338/1/T4C5L8Dx4RWQeWjjWLd0HqrsopnUmbVCrfPdVMH8.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Malay e-mel adapts English e-mail, linking the electronic prefix with mel, the Malay spelling of mail. Its vocabulary carries the familiar idea of correspondence into digital communication. Everyday typing sometimes drops the hyphen, producing emel, while DBP prescribes e-mel and records derived forms for sending messages electronically. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=E-mel)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records ek as conversational Malay meaning to show off. A DBP magazine discussion also places it among colloquial vocabulary associated with English contact. That classification supplies cultural context, but does not establish a particular English source word or a documented sequence of sound changes. [Dewan Bahasa, August 2020](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/majalah/2020/db82020/files/basic-html/page16.html)

etymology.historical_story: Ernie is commonly a familiar form of Ernest. Ernest has Germanic ancestry associated with earnestness or seriousness. The affectionate short form illustrates how a name can develop a warmer conversational register without changing the identity of its bearer. In Malay sentences, Ernie functions as a complete personal name rather than a Malay-derived word. [Nickname](https://dobryslownik.pl/slowo/Ernie/221070/), [Ernest](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Ernest).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把/ɜː.ni/联想成“厄尼”，记住Ernest的熟昵称呼Ernie；名字不表示本人一定“认真”。

etymology.historical_story: The international word family behind eksotik reaches back to Greek exōtikos, meaning foreign or from outside. That geographical idea later developed an association with unusual appeal. Malay preserves both perspectives: a plant can be eksotik because it comes from elsewhere, while a dish can be eksotik because its character seems strikingly unfamiliar. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/exotic), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=eksotik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eksotik 和英语 exotic 连起来：先想到“外来的”，再想到“新奇而有特色的”；首音节读 ek。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成名词；词根末尾的 a 与后缀的 a 分属两个音节。开头 e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/。

etymology.historical_story: Ejaan is formed from eja with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its cultural importance extends beyond classroom spelling: Malaysia and Indonesia introduced coordinated Roman spelling reforms on 16 August 1972. A word about arranging letters thus also recalls cooperation across national borders to make written language more consistent. [DBP spelling history](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ejaan+rumi+baharu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 e—ja—an 三拍念：eja 是“拼”，加 -an 就是“拼出来的形式或规则”。

etymology.historical_story: Edgar comes from Old English ēad, meaning wealth or prosperity, and gār, meaning spear. The [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2016/3/name/Edgar) documents medieval bearers and spellings. In modern Malay, however, Edgar functions as a person's name: its historical elements do not give it an ordinary Malay meaning such as rich or warrior.

etymology.historical_story: Expelliarmus belongs to the invented magical vocabulary of Harry Potter. The official spell guide connects its Latin-inspired wording with the idea of driving out a weapon, matching its disarming effect. Its memorable association with Harry makes it recognizable beyond individual scenes. This is a literary creation with a classical-language flavour, rather than a Malay derivative or an ordinary Latin expression.

senses.en_definition: Provisionally identified as Latin et, meaning “and,” as in et al. and et cetera.
senses.ms_definition: Jika digunakan sebagai unsur bahasa Latin, bermaksud dan, seperti dalam ungkapan et al. dan et cetera.

etymology.historical_story: Elektromagnetik belongs to international scientific vocabulary linking electricity with magnetism. Its electro- element ultimately recalls Greek elektron, meaning amber, while magnetic names the other half of the relationship. English electromagnetic is recorded from 1821. The Malay spelling adapts this scientific adjective to local orthography, making the connection visible in familiar terms such as gelombang elektromagnetik. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/electromagnetic).

etymology.historical_story: Eleanor reached English through Old French from the Occitan name Alienòr. Eleanor of Aquitaine helped make it prominent in medieval England. A familiar explanation connects it with the phrase meaning another Aenor, but the earliest history remains uncertain. Treating the name as definitively meaning light therefore gives learners more certainty than the evidence supports. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/eleanor).

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Korea, panggilan yang diletakkan selepas nama anak untuk menyapa atau merujuk ibu kepada anak tersebut.

etymology.historical_story: Eomma represents the Korean spelling 엄마 in Roman letters. Its cultural meaning comes from familiar family interaction: it names one's mother in informal settings and can follow a child's name to identify that child's mother. These uses explain its intimacy without establishing it as a Malay word. No verified history of its adoption into Malay is supplied here. [National Institute of Korean Language](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=67098&nation=eng)

etymology.historical_story: Ekar is the Malay adaptation of English acre. Behind the English word lies Old English æcer, meaning a field or cultivated land. Historical explanations connect the measure with the land a team of oxen could plough in a day. Its modern numerical definition turns that agricultural image into a fixed area. [Historical dictionary: æcer](https://bosworthtoller.com/347)

etymology.historical_story: Evans is commonly explained as a Welsh patronymic surname meaning son of Evan. It preserves a naming tradition in which a father's personal name helped identify a child, before such names became hereditary. This historical relationship does not make Evans a productive Malay derivative, and a modern bearer's nationality cannot be inferred from the surname alone. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/evans)

etymology.historical_story: Ekspresi is treated here as a complete borrowed lexical base, not as ekspres followed by a Malay suffix. Its established dictionary meaning connects inward feelings with outward words and gestures. Malay then builds mengekspresikan from that base using its own affixes. This illustrates how a borrowed word can participate in Malay word formation without every final letter being an affix. [DBP: ekspresi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ekspresi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 eks-pre-si 三拍读，想象情绪从心里走到脸上：ekspresi muka 是表情，ekspresi diri 是自我表达。

etymology.historical_story: Everyone illustrates how two English words can become a single grammatical unit: every supplies the inclusive meaning, while one points to a person. Modern English distinguishes this pronoun from the separate phrase every one. Its appearance inside a Malay conversation is code-switching, rather than evidence that it has become an official Malay headword. See [Canadian Department of Justice](https://justice.canada.ca/eng/rp-pr/csj-sjc/legis-redact/legistics/p1p6.html).

etymology.historical_story: Names can enter Malay frequency lists through biographies, research citations and institutional labels. Ellis illustrates this possibility: Universiti Putra Malaysia uses Zon Ellis in connection with Albert Ellis. That attested name does not establish the identity of this lowercase token. Its personal-name history, pronunciation and source referent remain unresolved without the original passage.

etymology.historical_story: English engineer developed from medieval French words associated with devising and constructing engines, especially military machines. Its deeper ancestry connects with Latin ingenium, meaning natural ability or ingenuity. The occupation later broadened beyond military machinery. In Malaysian Malay conversation, the English job title appears through code-switching alongside the standard Malay equivalent jurutera. [English word history](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/engineer).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“恩—金—尼尔”，重音在最后；把熟悉的 engine 与设计机器的 engineer 连起来记，但工程师的工作远不止发动机。

senses.zh_definition: 令人困惑、难以理解或解释的人或事物；谜一般的存在。
senses.en_definition: A person or thing that is puzzling or difficult to understand.
senses.ms_definition: Seseorang atau sesuatu yang membingungkan.
senses.nuances: 较书面，常见于文学、评论和悬疑叙述。强调难以理解，不一定涉及有人刻意保密；普通谈话也可用 misteri 或 sesuatu yang sukar difahami。马来语释义展开自 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=enigma)。

etymology.historical_story: Enigma ultimately comes from Greek ainigma, meaning a riddle or obscure saying, through Latin aenigma. Its history connects puzzling language with puzzling people and events: something can be clearly present yet remain difficult to interpret. Malay uses the borrowed word for that same intellectual uncertainty. The ultimate origin does not establish its immediate borrowing route into Malay. [Etymology source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/enigma).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 enigma 想成贴在神秘人物身上的“谜”字：人就在眼前，心思却解不开。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆作 e- 与 -fek。DBP 标作 é.fék，两个 e 均为 e taling，不读作弱元音 /ə/。

etymology.historical_story: Efek belongs to the European word family represented by Dutch effect and English effect, ultimately connected with Latin effectus, an accomplishment or result. Its borrowing history is commonly traced through Dutch. Malay dictionaries preserve both an ordinary consequence meaning and a financial securities meaning, showing how related European vocabulary entered the region through more than one sphere of activity. [Wikikamus: efek](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/efek); [DBP: efek](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=efek)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: efek 听起来像英语 effect：看到视频里的 efek，先想“效果”；遇到股票、债券语境，再切换到“证券”。

etymology.historical_story: Entiti belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English entity, whose ancestry reaches medieval Latin entitas and Latin ens, an existing thing. The historical image is simply something that exists in its own right. Malay preserves that broad idea, allowing the word to describe a distinct organization, object, or conceptual unit. The immediate borrowing route is not established here. [Merriam-Webster: entity](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/entity).

etymology.historical_story: English explorer is formed from explore with the agent suffix -er: someone who explores. The noun is recorded from the late seventeenth century. etymology.historical_story: Ember entered Indonesian from Dutch emmer, meaning bucket, as documented in Indonesia’s official inventory of loanwords. Its familiar household meaning travelled with the borrowed name. DBP records ember with an Indonesian usage label and explains it through timba and baldi, illustrating how neighbouring language varieties can share an object while favouring different everyday names. [Senarai Kata Serapan](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/4383/1/Senarai%20Kata%20Serapan%20Dalam%20Bahasa%20Indonesia%201995.pdf)

senses.nuances: 主要为英式及相关技术语域用法，美式对应 ground。它表示电气连接，并非把设备埋入泥土。[Collins：earth](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/earth)。

senses.zh_definition: 狐狸或獾等动物在地下的洞穴。
senses.en_definition: An underground den, especially that of a fox or badger.
senses.ms_definition: Lubang atau sarang bawah tanah, khususnya bagi rubah atau badger.
senses.nuances: 可数名词，主要见于英国自然观察及相关叙述，不是所有动物巢穴的通用词。[Chambers：earth](https://chambers.co.uk/search/?query=earth&title=21st&xref=21C12503)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam rajah pendawaian itu, label Inggeris 'earth' merujuk kepada sambungan bumi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该接线图中，英语标签 earth 指接地连接。
dual_scenarios.en: In the wiring diagram, the English label 'earth' refers to the ground connection.

etymology.historical_story: Earth is inherited from Germanic and is recorded in Old English. Its long history embraces both the ground beneath people's feet and the world they inhabit. Later specialist uses include electrical terminology. This breadth explains why Malay translation requires different words: bumi for the planet, tanah for soil, and technical forms for earthing. [Oxford English Dictionary：earth](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/5000214824)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头由脚下泥土拉远到整颗地球：earth 可指 tanah，也可指 bumi；看到电气图中的 earth，再联想到“接地”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中按外来整词处理，不把英语内部的构词成分当作马来语词缀。音标列示英语的一种常见读法；专业借词的本地读音可能不同。

senses.zh_definition: 电梯；在建筑物楼层之间运送人员或货物的升降设备。此义主要是英语用法，马来西亚标准马来语通常称 lif。
senses.en_definition: A lift carrying people or goods between floors of a building.
senses.ms_definition: Alat yang membawa orang atau barang dari satu tingkat bangunan ke tingkat yang lain; lazimnya disebut lif dalam bahasa Melayu Malaysia.
senses.nuances: 作为英语词可出现在马英混合口语、标识或引文中；一般马来语叙述优先使用 lif。DBP 的英马词典将此义标为美国英语并译作 lif。下列搭配展示混合语境中的用法，规范马来语分别为 menaiki lif 和 lif penumpang。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bijirin)

senses.zh_definition: 提升机；将物料向上输送的机械设备。
senses.en_definition: A machine for raising materials, including a continuous belt or bucket lifting mechanism.
senses.ms_definition: Mesin pengangkat atau penaik yang digunakan untuk mengangkut bahan ke aras yang lebih tinggi.
senses.nuances: 这是机械领域的英语词义；马来语可按设备类型使用 mesin pengangkat、mesin penaik 或更具体的术语。不能将所有 elevator 一律译为建筑物电梯。下列组合用于说明设备类型。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bijirin)，[Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/elevator)

senses.zh_definition: 〔医学〕起挺器；用于将牙齿从牙槽中挺出，或抬起凹陷骨片的器械。
senses.en_definition: A medical instrument used to elevate a tooth from its socket or raise a depressed bone fragment.
senses.ms_definition: Alat perubatan untuk mengeluarkan gigi daripada soketnya atau menaikkan bahagian tulang patah yang tertekan.
senses.nuances: DBP 医学术语资料将 elevator 同时列为源语和马来语目标术语，并说明其牙科及骨科用途。因此不能把本词所有出现都当作口语英语混用。此处释义为整合改写。[DBP 医学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=patah+I+1+)

dual_scenarios.ms: Doktor gigi menggunakan elevator untuk melonggarkan gigi sebelum mencabutnya dengan forsep.
dual_scenarios.zh: 牙医先用牙挺松动牙齿，再用牙钳将其拔除。
dual_scenarios.en: The dentist used a dental elevator to loosen the tooth before extracting it with forceps.

etymology.historical_story: The central image of elevator is something that raises. English applies the word to lifting machinery as well as certain surgical instruments. Malaysian usage requires attention to context: DBP translates the building transport sense as lif, while also recording elevator as a medical term. The same spelling can therefore signal an English expression or an established specialist borrowing. [DBP English–Malay dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bijirin), [DBP medical terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=patah+I+1+)

headword.verification_note: 这是英语形式，不能标为马来语官方词。常见名词用法是 egg 的复数，马来语对应 telur。数据包的 is_root=true 与英语形态分析不符，以下据实际构词更正；爪夷文和音节缺值保留。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语屈折变化：名词中 -s 表示复数；动词中可表示一般现在时第三人称单数。浊辅音 /ɡ/ 后的 -s 读 /z/，不增加音节。名词 egg 与表示怂恿的动词 egg 是不同词源的同形词。

senses.zh_definition: 蛋；卵。英语 egg 的复数，指鸟类、爬行动物等产下的卵，也常指供食用的禽蛋。
senses.en_definition: The plural of egg: reproductive bodies laid by birds and various other animals, especially birds' eggs used as food.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak bahasa Inggeris bagi egg, yang merujuk kepada telur haiwan, khususnya telur unggas yang dimakan.
senses.nuances: 英语形式，不是马来语复数构词。马来语通常用 telur；有数量词时可说 dua biji telur，不添加 -s。以下搭配给出马来语对应表达。释义为编写释义，英语词义参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/egg?topic=animal-reproduction)。

senses.zh_definition: 卵细胞；卵子。英语 egg 的复数，指雌性生殖细胞。
senses.en_definition: Female reproductive cells; ova.
senses.ms_definition: Sel pembiakan betina, iaitu ovum; dalam konteks ini eggs ialah bentuk jamak bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 生物学语境的细胞义，不一定指带壳的蛋。马来语可依对象使用 ovum 或 sel telur。英语词义参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/egg?topic=animal-reproduction)。

senses.zh_definition: 向……投掷鸡蛋。英语动词 egg 的一般现在时第三人称单数形式。
senses.en_definition: Throws eggs at someone or something; the third-person singular present form of egg.
senses.ms_definition: Melontarkan telur ke arah seseorang atau sesuatu; bentuk kata kerja bahasa Inggeris bagi subjek orang ketiga tunggal dalam kala kini.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词用法，不能解释为马来语词缀变化。是否为此义须看宾语与句子结构。英语词义参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/egg?topic=animal-reproduction)。

senses.zh_definition: 在 eggs someone on 结构中表示怂恿、煽动某人做某事，常涉及不明智或冒险的行为。
senses.en_definition: In eggs someone on, encourages or urges someone to act, often unwisely.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan eggs someone on, menghasut atau menggalakkan seseorang melakukan sesuatu, lazimnya tindakan yang kurang bijak.
senses.nuances: 该义通常须连同小品词 on 理解，不应由孤立的 eggs 推定。它与表示蛋的名词词源不同。英语短语义参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/egg-someone-on)。

collocations.zh: 怂恿某人继续那种行为

etymology.historical_story: The English noun egg comes through Middle English from Old Norse egg. It became established alongside, and eventually displaced, forms descended from the older English word for the same everyday object. Eggs adds the regular English plural ending. The verb in egg someone on has a separate history and should not be explained through eggs as food. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/egg)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 一颗 egg，多颗 eggs；尾音读 /z/。换成马来语记 telur，数量交给 dua biji 等表达。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，在此表示领属或回指，并非派生词缀；suffix 是本结构中的位置分类。词根末尾 n 保留，ny 表示 /ɲ/，可分音节为 en.jin.nya。headword.jawi 按包保留词根拼写；完整词形为 اينجينڽ。-nya 与前词连写。[DBP 拼写规范](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的发动机；在上下文中也指前述车辆或机器的发动机。
senses.en_definition: His or her engine; in context, the engine of a previously mentioned vehicle or machine.
senses.ms_definition: Enjin milik orang yang dirujuk; dalam konteks kenderaan atau mesin, enjin yang berkaitan dengan kenderaan atau mesin tersebut. Enjin ialah mesin untuk menukar tenaga kepada daya atau gerakan mekanik.
senses.nuances: -nya 不区分男性与女性，具体指代须由上下文判断。enjinnya 是 enjin 加附着代词的组合形式，词类仍为名词。正式技术文件如有歧义，可明确写 enjin kenderaan tersebut。[DBP enjin 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enjin)。

etymology.historical_story: Enjin is a Malay adaptation of English engine, with j representing the affricate heard in the English source. Enjinnya then combines that borrowed noun with the Malay attached pronoun -nya. The result illustrates how an imported technical word can participate in ordinary Malay grammar without needing a separate dictionary meaning for every possessive form. [USM study of loanword spelling](https://apjee.usm.my/JPP_03_1981/Jilid%2003%20Artikel%2010.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: enjin 听起来像 engine；接上 -nya，把镜头指回前面的人或车辆：enjin + nya＝他／她／它的引擎。

etymology.historical_story: Engkaulah combines the personal pronoun engkau with the emphatic particle -lah. Its expressive force comes from identifying the listener: you are the person who matters here. The same pronoun can address a close companion or, with capitalization, God in prayer. Those settings explain its unusually wide emotional range. See [DBP on -lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel).

etymology.historical_story: Elegan belongs to an international vocabulary of refinement, comparable with English elegant and French élégant. The French form derives from Latin elegans, associated with distinction and good taste. The sources consulted do not establish the immediate donor language for Malaysian Malay. DBP anchors the Malay meaning in a handsome, neat, and graceful appearance. [French Academy etymology](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9E0751)

etymology.historical_story: Esther is known internationally through the biblical queen whose story is set at the Persian court. Its deeper origin remains debated: scholars have compared it with a Persian word for star and with the name Ishtar. Neither proposal makes Esther the ordinary Malay word for star; in present usage it functions as a personal name. [University of Iowa](https://bam.sites.uiowa.edu/hello/esther)

etymology.historical_story: Energi belongs to the international vocabulary associated with energy, but neighbouring languages do not always choose the same technical label. DBP’s MABBIM tables place energi in Indonesian expressions while giving tenaga in their Malaysian counterparts. Reading across the country columns reveals an important cultural lesson: shared scientific concepts can retain different local names. [DBP terminology tables](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=energy).

etymology.historical_story: Eastwood is an English surname associated with several places bearing that name. Many such place names combine Old English elements meaning east and wood. Their histories are not identical, however: the Nottinghamshire name has a different second element in its earlier forms. The name should therefore be learned as a proper name rather than assigned one universal literal meaning. [Name history](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Eastwood)

morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词作为独立词素记忆；不按马来语词缀拆分。所列 IPA 为西班牙语常见读法，实际发音以本人为准。

etymology.historical_story: Emilio is a Spanish and Italian form of the ancient Roman family name Aemilius. GfdS notes that its ultimate meaning remains uncertain, although a connection with Latin aemulor, expressing emulation or striving to equal someone, has been proposed. This history explains its relationship to Emilia without making 'rival' a literal modern definition of every person named Emilio. [GfdS](https://gfds.de/vorname-der-woche-emilio/).

morphology.formula: elok + -lah → eloklah（好／合适 + 语气强调或委婉劝告）
morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是后附语气小品词，此处按字段归入 suffix，并非改变词类的派生后缀。elok 的 e 为 é，读 /e/；词尾 k 在常见马来西亚读法中为 /ʔ/，接 -lah 时可保留。输入爪夷文 ايلوق 仅对应 elok，未包含 -lah；音节字段原为 null，予以保留。

senses.zh_definition: 好、妥当、合适；附加 -lah 后可表示赞同，也常用于委婉建议“最好……、还是……为好”。
senses.en_definition: Good, satisfactory or appropriate; with -lah, also used to endorse a situation or recommend a course of action.
senses.ms_definition: Baik, bagus atau sesuai; dengan partikel -lah, menyatakan penegasan atau anjuran supaya sesuatu dilakukan.
senses.nuances: Eloklah begitu 表示“这样就好”；eloklah kita… 常译为“我们最好……”。劝告义来自整句结构和语气，并非 -lah 自身等于“应该”。标准语中同样可用，并非仅属口语。词义依据：[DBP：elok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=elok)；此处马来语释义按完整形式编写，非词典逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 美观、漂亮、悦目；-lah 可加强对外观的肯定，具体感情色彩由语调决定。
senses.en_definition: Attractive or pleasing in appearance, with -lah adding emphasis or affirmation.
senses.ms_definition: Cantik atau menarik pada pandangan, dengan partikel -lah sebagai penegas.
senses.nuances: 这是词干 elok 的外观义；以下为词干的常见搭配，实际句子可按语境附加 -lah。-lah 不表示比较级或最高级。

etymology.historical_story: Elok ialah kata dasar yang merangkumi kecantikan dan kebaikan. Kamus Dewan turut merekodkan peribahasa yang menghubungkan keelokan tegur sapa dengan kasih semasa hidup, serta keelokan budi dengan kenangan selepas mati. Hubungan ini memperlihatkan bahawa elok boleh menilai rupa dan tingkah laku. Bentuk eloklah menambahkan partikel penegas pada kata dasar itu.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eloklah 记成“好啦，最好这样做”：elok 管“好”，-lah 管语气；这是联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian conversation, an English word can appear inside an otherwise Malay sentence, especially when speakers discuss cars or technical work. Engine should therefore be distinguished from enjin, the spelling recorded in Malay dictionaries. This entry documents that language boundary; the packet supplies no evidence for dating the borrowing or reconstructing its earliest local use.

etymology.historical_story: DBP records ee as an attention-getting exclamation associated with surprise or astonishment. Its dictionary pronunciation cue, éé, points to e taling, while actual delivery depends on emotion and intonation. The supplied evidence establishes its conversational function but offers no documented donor language, first attestation, or historical anecdote; none should be invented to explain it.

etymology.historical_story: The hesitation spelling err represents a pause sound rather than a recoverable Malay root. English dictionaries describe er as a written hesitation signal; an additional r can likewise suggest a prolonged sound in informal writing, though this does not prove a borrowing history. Separately, the English verb err descends through French from Latin errare, meaning to stray. [Hesitation sound](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/er); [verb history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/err).

etymology.historical_story: Europe's name is traditionally connected with Europa, a princess in Greek mythology. That cultural association survives on modern euro banknotes, where her portrait appears as a security feature. For Malay learners, the useful distinction is regional spelling: Eropa occurs in Indonesian, while Malaysian Malay uses Eropah. The myth explains a cultural association rather than establishing the name's ultimate linguistic origin. [European Central Bank](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/euro/banknotes/europa/html/index.en.html)

etymology.historical_story: Electra preserves the Greek name Elektra. Ancient visual art already depicted her meeting Orestes at their father's tomb, showing how closely storytelling, theatre and images interacted. A fifth-century BCE terracotta relief preserves that scene. This cultural history establishes the name's antiquity, but does not establish which Electra the supplied token denotes. [Canellopoulos Museum](https://camu.gr/en/item/miliako-anaglyfo-me-parastasi-ilektras-kai-oresti-ston-tafo-tou-agamemnona/).

senses.nuances: 在网络安全语境中与人员撤离不同；也可用于经授权的模拟测试，因此不能只凭 exfil 就断言发生真实盗窃。此处马来文为说明性释义。MITRE 的工具资料使用 Exfil Operation 指数据外传相关操作，参见 [MITRE Stockpile](https://github.com/mitre/stockpile/blob/master/data/sources/2ccb822c-088a-4664-8976-91be8879bc1d.yml)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语网络安全行话：将数据从系统传出，通常带有秘密或未经授权的含义。
senses.en_definition: To transfer data out of a system, typically covertly or without authorization.
senses.ms_definition: Memindahkan data keluar daripada sistem, biasanya secara tersembunyi atau tanpa kebenaran.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词嵌入马来语句子的用法，不是已确认的标准马来语派生动词。面向普通读者时，宜写 memindahkan data keluar tanpa kebenaran。英语技术用法参见 [MITRE APT3 分析](https://attack.mitre.org/docs/APT3_Adversary_Emulation_Plan.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Exfil is an English clipping associated with exfiltration and exfiltrate. Military language uses the underlying idea for getting personnel out of an operational area; games adapt it into an extraction objective. Cybersecurity uses the same outward movement for data leaving a system. These English uses do not by themselves establish an official Malay borrowing.

etymology.historical_story: Eisenheim has independently documented geographical and fictional uses. A German municipality bears the name, while Steven Millhauser's story Eisenheim the Illusionist supplied the basis for the 2006 film. Neither use establishes a Malay lexical origin, and the packet does not identify which referent occurred in its source text. [Municipality](https://www.eisenheim.de/); [film credits](https://philipglass.com/films/illusionist/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Eisenheim，先问“德国地名，还是电影魔术师？”把名字和所指对象一起记忆。

senses.zh_definition: 大型种植园或农园；《Kamus Dewan》第四版指面积超过一百英亩、种植橡胶、椰子等作物的农场。
senses.en_definition: A large plantation or agricultural estate, defined in Kamus Dewan Fourth Edition as exceeding one hundred acres.
senses.ms_definition: Ladang atau kebun yang luasnya melebihi seratus ekar, misalnya untuk tanaman getah atau kelapa.
senses.nuances: 在马来西亚农业语境中通常指规模较大的种植产业，不是泛指任何小菜园，也不必然包含豪宅。“超过一百英亩”是所给词典的释义界定，不能据此推定所有行政或行业分类标准。参见 [DBP：estet](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=estet)。

senses.zh_definition: 已进行建筑开发、供特定用途使用的区域；常见于工业园区等名称。
senses.en_definition: A developed area containing buildings for a particular use, especially industrial premises.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan yang telah dimajukan dengan pembinaan bangunan seperti kilang untuk kegunaan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这一义项侧重经过开发的区域，不要求种植作物。estet perindustrian 指工业园区；不要直接套用英语 estate 的所有义项，例如遗产或遗产总额。参见 [DBP：estet](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=estet)。

etymology.historical_story: Estet is the Malay adaptation of English estate. Its dictionary meanings offer a useful picture of how a landholding term becomes specialized: one sense names a large agricultural property, while another names a developed area containing buildings such as factories. Remembering both landscapes, plantation rows and industrial premises, helps prevent the mistaken assumption that every estet must be a farm.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: estet 与英语 estate 连起来记：想象一大片有统一管理的土地；种树是种植园，建工厂可成工业园区。

senses.en_definition: A traditional Japanese cap, typically black, associated with historical men's dress and certain ceremonial or theatrical costumes.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis penutup kepala tradisional Jepun, lazimnya berwarna hitam, yang digunakan dalam pakaian lelaki bersejarah serta sesetengah upacara dan persembahan.
senses.nuances: 按日语文化术语 烏帽子 解释，尚无资料确认其为 DBP 核定的马来语普通词，因此 status 使用 foreign_term；马来语释义为编写释义。不同形制、材质和使用者不能一概而论，也不是所有日本帽子的总称。所列为说明性搭配，排名仅沿用输入资料。[实物说明：兰斯博物馆](https://musees-reims.fr/oeuvre/bonnet-de-samourai-284813892436241854)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于日本服饰、博物馆和表演讨论。说明具体展品时以展签为准，避免把任何黑帽、神职冠帽或武士头盔都称作 eboshi。

etymology.historical_story: Eboshi is the Japanese name written 烏帽子. A nineteenth-century example in the Reims museum collections combines silk, lacquer and cotton. The museum explains that earlier caps were soft and foldable, with lacquer later helping them hold their shape. Different forms developed for different social groups and functions, so the word names a historical family of caps rather than one uniform design. [Source: Reims Museums](https://musees-reims.fr/oeuvre/bonnet-de-samourai-284813892436241854)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 e-bo-shi 三拍记音，再把词形与“乌帽子”这顶黑色传统冠帽的画面相连；不要拆成马来语词缀。
